The First Formula of the延生 (Longevity) Method

Use charcoal fire; take the four medicinals, grind them into a paste until thoroughly done. Place pre-prepared cinnabar on the ground on new earth, with the hair/fiber underneath.

Grind to a fine powder, water-fly (levigiate) it; cover and calcine, retaining the nature; grind the vessel contents into powder; heat until smoke stops, then remove and take.

Decoct the mother's breast milk into a strong decoction; take one to two fen per day; mix internally and use twice before; apply externally.

Formula for the Smallpox-Prevention Rabbit Red Pill

Also known as Blood Musk Intestine Pill. On the eighth day of the first lunar month, collect a live rabbit. Add musk and other ingredients.

Grind to an extremely fine powder; mix thoroughly into the interior; apply externally over two days before use.

For recurring smallpox sores, pustules, and skin lesions: grind all medicinals to an extremely fine powder, mix thoroughly, and apply externally over two days.

translation:
Pustular sores are also one manifestation of seasonal qi (epidemic disease).

Signs and Symptoms: In serious cases there may be confusion, facial flushing, incoherent speech, or one may distinguish them by spontaneous sweating, or diarrhea, or fever, or absence of fever. The key to identifying measles rashes is that there must be red streaks and crimson lines behind the ears and on the back of the neck — this is the true sign. If the kidney organ shows none of these signs, it is easy to distinguish. One must look behind the ears; if there are true red streaks — fine crimson lines behind the ears along the kidney meridian pathway — these are genuine. The red streaks are fine black dots the size of millet grains. The condition may present with chills in form but heat in qi. Starting from behind the ears, if true red streaks appear, this confirms the diagnosis. The toxin swells and rises; when it does, this is called the rising of toxic swellings.

The Five Types of Pustular Sores

Sores of various colors may be either favorable or unfavorable. In each location where pus forms, there is a corresponding sign. White-centered sores are associated with the heart organ and watery fluid. Greenish sores are associated with the liver. Each of the five colors corresponds to one of the five organs.

In mild cases, the true color of the rash may be purple-black, with the root forming beneath the skin surface, hidden and faint within the muscle and flesh. When the toxin has aged and matured, it is called the condition where the white membrane of pus is abundant, and the toxin is then identified as bean-pox rash.

The toxin of the heart produces the eruption of pox and rash. The various fluids are stored in the liver; the main governing is pale below. The color when it emerges from the heart is blue-green and small. The pus sores emerge bearing names relating to wood and fluid.

translation:
Various Manifestations of Smallpox (Douchuang)

When the color is white and large, the heart governs the pox and its blood; when the color is red and small, pus forms with water pox. Water pox are large, while water pox pustules, glandular water pox, and small-disease water pox are similar in appearance.

Among eruptions, measles (mahen) is the largest, water pox the smallest, and ordinary pox intermediate. Measles resemble small hidden eruptions, like sesame seeds. Next are those commonly called other names by the people.

Those who bathe in water will see the mud-like residue diminish; these are itching pox that the people commonly call by various names, resembling water pox in appearance.

Blood-type: medicine is taken internally; few pustules emerge, hence small. Water pox are large by comparison.

From the onset of fever with chills and heat, passing through three to six days of the febrile cycle, the initial stage progresses to the reporting of the pox eruption.

From the onset of fever to the full eruption, one distinguishes among miscellaneous manifestations, modified manifestations, and water-detoxifying treatments. One must carefully address the skin's dryness and heat, strictly prohibiting certain foods or activities; the underlying process of suppuration and resolution must be managed through appropriate channels.

Treatment Methods for Smallpox (Douchuang)

Nourishment must be appropriate: keep the patient clean, help expel lung toxins, allow the process to flow quickly so the eyes remain clear, the membranes become free of scarring and ulceration. One must not allow the skin and membranes to form scars or ulcerations from the disease.

It is appropriate to warm and resolve: keep the patient warm, and pox will easily resolve and heal.

After recovery, avoid both cold and excessive heat; help expel lung toxins so the process completes quickly without scarring.

When eruptions appear with visible swelling, and fever with sweating becomes pronounced, the condition may become difficult to treat; at that time, gentle warming and resolution is key.

If the pox lie hidden beneath the skin with internal heat, they cannot properly erupt and mature — this is what determines whether the pox will develop fully in season.

On Regulating and Recuperation: When pox appear slowly and emerge late, and the root nests are deep and deficient, one should use only warm and balanced medicines, and recovery should follow. When the pox rash is about to emerge, the qi within is called out — one yawn, a great [sigh]. The actual pox sores and ointment are like the ears and nape in cold damage [diseases], with the eyes blinking.

If [the patient is] deficient and weak with qi diminishing over many days, during the three days of spontaneous fever, three days of eruption, through the drying of the pox — within twelve days from onset — one may protect and stabilize [the patient].

If the formation [of pox] is the most acute, if [the patient is] deficient and weak with qi diminishing over many days, [the physician should work to] preserve stability day by day.

When fever begins, the five viscera are stirred; during fever, drowsiness and somnolence appear — this is because the five viscera are being stored [with heat]. The lung heat generates fright; or lung heat erupts — the kidney's body [shows] no [normal] signs; this turns toward the lung below, and involves the liver as well, over time.

Frequent desire to eat, red [complexion], coughing — these are the signs. Because the fever resembles Shanghan (cold damage), one should use Shengma Gegen Decoction.

When pox erupts and causes lower back pain, urgently administer Sinhaetang (Spirit-Resolving Decoction) to induce sweating until the pain stops, so as to prevent the fetal toxin from erupting. When the toxin in the viscera and bowels has already been distinguished, it comes from outside; it is appropriate to use the four substances for cold-damage aching and pain. The heat in the flesh and skin rises and falls: five days already in the interior manifesting, five days on the surface ripening, three days without visible eruption, three days not yet in the interior erupting.

When the red coating on the outside has not yet revealed the evil pathogen, it means the interior has been fully expelled. Coming from outside, it is appropriate to induce sweating until the pain stops, so as to free the fetal toxin.

The red coating on the outside has not yet revealed the evil pathogen; it manifests as fever. With dispersal, urgently use sparse [treatment] to clear the viscera and bowels.

Look at the signs: if eruptions come out during fever, applied above, the sores will resolve. Five days already on the surface ripening, five days still in the interior erupting, three days without visible eruption.

Observe the shape and condition: if after the fever the body has no great heat but abdominal pain and lumbar pain that is inauspicious, do not take medicine for three days.

Auspicious and Inauspicious Signs During Fever

If there is joy [i.e., good signs] during fever, and the patient does not scratch the pustules so that they remain dry, this is ominous. If convulsions occur during the fever, and there is great pain in the abdomen and lower back as if insects are moving inside, that is ominous.

If the pustules are not scratched and remain intact, this is auspicious. If convulsions occur during fever with great abdominal and lumbar pain as if insects are moving, that is ominous.

The eruptions appear first on the chest and flanks, then spread outward; if the hands have them during fever, that is ominous.

All appear first on the chest and flanks, spreading outward.

Augmented Defeat-Toxin Powder (Gamibaedog-san)

Decoct and take orally. Apply patches to promote sweating. The base formula omits Ginseng and Poria; add Platycodon root, Cnidium rhizome, Notopterygium root, Gastrodia rhizome, Pubescent Angelica root, Lycium bark, Schizonepeta, Peppermint, each three pun. Slice and prepare.

Add Arnebia/Lithospermum (purple herb), Korean ginseng, Poria, Perilla, Ephedra, and green onion whites.

translation:
Red Cotton Powder (紅綿散): Total one dose. Ingredients: Red chrysanthemum, mint spikes, purple herb, gastrodia (tianma), cicada slough, water — each 5 fen. Slice and prepare.

Augmented Six-Flavor Powder (加味六味散): Treats flaring heat; when heat is excessive with manic agitation and measles eruptions — 6 qian of purplish-black [herb].

One lamp-wick decoction with water-levigated preparation, taken with water. For a child of ten years with flying heat and sparse pox eruption, in the third month of fever, take 3 tablets. Six liang of [ingredient], ground and water-levigated. Fine powder of licorice root, blended evenly five parts. For children in spring and autumn, use accordingly.

Powder: Disperses and can resolve toxin in sparse measles eruptions that emerge purplish-red — also effective for defeating toxin. For a child of 5 years, separately grind and add: fine powder of licorice root, 6 qian; in spring, red [herb].

Spirit-Resolving Decoction (神解湯): Treats sparse measles eruptions that come out swollen and painful. Purple [Bupleurum] and other [herbs], 8 fen each; half-dried kudzu root.

Four-Substance Muscle-Resolving Decoction (四物解肌湯): Divide and take again. Slice the right ingredients; one decoction serves as one packet. Upon taking, the [eruptions] will emerge. Yellow-white kidney pox eruptions and blisters will resolve at the root. This decoction method uses licorice to substitute for ginger tea — a cooling and regulating formula.

This decoction is for the same [condition]. These four types of pox and blister eruptions, when the covering has not yet resolved, use sweet and acrid cooling formulas.

Emergence of Pox on the Three Days: On day one, fever begins immediately; after pox emerge. On day two, measles appear — day two is mild; days three through five are more serious.

[From the body and rash appearing, to the joints of the feet, where the rash aligns — stopping treatment at the proper time; pox at the initial stage, days one and two — there are methods to manage and treat accordingly.]

translation:
This page discusses smallpox (痘瘡) and measles (麻疹), their differentiation and treatment.

If the root of the pox lesion is red, the top is rounded and raised, firm and hard to the touch — these are pox sores (痘瘡). If the root is not red, the top has no clear fluid, and the surface feels smooth — these are measles (麻疹).

When the rash first appears faintly, the toxin begins to disperse. If the rash is red and the toxin transforms, one may use a toxin-dispersing drink (化毒飲), or if the body does not respond quickly, one should stimulate eruption. If after using the medicine for three days the toxin does not come out fully, and if after further dosing the eruption does not appear, this means the patient's constitution is such that the lesions are sparse and should not be further forced out.

For treating heat toxins, use防風湯 (Fangfeng Decoction) to guide and resolve the condition. For wild delirium with accumulation of toxin inside, use appropriate decoctions suited to the stage of the disease.

For external treatments involving silkworm slough (蠶蛻) to discharge toxins and promote rapid eruption through the skin to resolve miliaria and heat rash, various methods are described. For conditions such as flying sores (飛瘡), scalded-skin-type lesions, and recurrent eruptions, specific formulas using Purple Herb (紫草) and Shengma (升麻) decoctions are prescribed.

When there is extreme excess heat with blood and qi stagnation, cooling and detoxifying formulas are appropriate. Formulas including 四聖散 (Four Sages Powder) and 紫草飲 (Purple Herb Drink), along with silkworm cocoon preparations, cool the surface and address internal accumulation. Symptoms including thirst, dense rash, concentrated lesions, body surface heat, agitation, and eye discharge should be treated with Shengma (升麻) and Qiao (翹) based decoctions.

translation:
Signs of Favorable and Unfavorable Outcomes When Pox Erupts

One should use Detoxifying Decoction (Sodok-eum) with modifications. When pox does not erupt smoothly, add wine-fried scutellaria and coptis; externally apply Eye-Protecting Ointment.

When pox turns purple, add red flower; if it immediately turns black, the kidneys are affected. The pox sign: use water pearl; if it turns red, this indicates excessive fire; the prognosis depends on elemental balance — if good, the patient recovers.

If the pox begins like millet seeds, appearing red, and if water blisters form, prevention depends on elemental balance. If the pox suppresses and the hands and feet become soft and show no clear form, this is a dangerous sign.

After six or seven days, if the color resembles pus and fat, add brine; if it disperses with purple herb, and if red flowers and yellow macules appear on the face and do not fully form, with purplish-black shells developing — this is critical.

When the pox turns ash-black and death is near, urgently use Brine Toxin Decoction. When pox erupts with red flush and yellow spots on the face that do not properly form and have purple discoloration, this is dangerous.

Detoxifying Drink (Sodok-eum): ineffective when pox does not emerge; use with smartweed, three to four doses to disperse quickly.

Ledebouriella root, five fen each; or make into pill with two qian of fine herb, jing-jie, used quickly in three to four doses to disperse thoroughly.

Take with wine to treat pox that does not erupt smoothly; grind into juice and add salt, hawthorn, and licorice root.

Toxin-Transforming Decoction (Hwadok-tang):
Ledebouriella root, five fen each.
Take with wine to treat pox that does not erupt smoothly; grind into juice with additions of salt, hawthorn, and licorice.

translation:
[Title: Miraculous Effects of Medicines]

Rhinoceros Horn Detoxifying Drink: Treats pox and rashes; arctium (burdock) seed can quickly promote eruption, or if already erupted and heat-cooked, urgently resolves. Cut ingredients: rhinoceros horn shavings, licorice, each boiled together; five to two qian of schizonepetae spica (jing jie), ledebouriella (fang feng), scutellaria (huang qin). Decoct and take to manage toxin; if wind-toxin is excessive after seven days, use rehmannia root bark and phellodendron bark.

Detoxifying Ledebouriella Decoction: Various ingredients, cut and decocted — arctium root, schizonepetae spica, fang feng, one qian; for severe toxin accumulation, use cortex lycii radicis and phellodendron.

Muscle-Penetrating Decoction: Treats pox eruptions that are slow to come out; accelerates eruption. Glutinous rice and various herbs, ground into powder, decocted once separately, administered; one qian each.

Four Sages Powder: Treats large and small pox eruptions; grind ingredients equally into powder; decoct together once separately with water; includes aurantii fructus immaturus and licorice. Decoct purple gromwell root (zi cao), taro wood in water; take orally to resolve eruptions.

Augmented Four Sages Powder: For pox eruptions that are slow to appear, or for adverse conditions such as inversion — includes ginger, chuanxiong, cicada molting (chan tui), two fen each; cut and make one packet, added to glutinous rice water, bitter ginseng, licorice. Decoct and take to promote full eruption.

translation:
Quick-Rash Powder (快斑散): Treats pox sores that emerge slowly, or that are driven inward by wind and remain hidden just beneath the surface, not yet fully erupted. Ingredients: Lithospermum root (紫草茸), cicada slough (蟬蛻), ginseng (人參) — each 6 fen; or akebia stem (木通) 3 fen; licorice root (甘草) 2.5 fen. Cut and decoct in water; take orally with water.

Purple Herb Drink (紫草飲): Treats pox sores that are slow to emerge — after three or four days they remain faintly hidden and about to come out but have not yet appeared. Bring a decoction to a fine boil with lithospermum; take one he (合) dose. For large sores, they will promptly erupt. Use the root decoction to promote bowel movement.

Silk Gourd Decoction (絲瓜湯): Stir into the decoction old sugar to promote eruption of pox and rashes. Prepare half a dose; alternatively, char the skin and seeds of the silk gourd (preserving nature), powder it; also prepare licorice in decoction. Combine with lithospermum.

Forsythia and Cimicifuga Decoction (連翹升麻湯): Decoct and take orally. Effective for causing eruption in persons with dense, full-body surface heat from pox rash. Use urgently to prevent later complications. This is essentially Cimicifuga-Kudzu Decoction (升麻葛根湯) with added cicada slough. If the rash is sticky and clustered, add forsythia (連翹) as the single key herb.

Burdock Seed Decoction (鼠粘子湯): Treats pox rash with dense eruptions and surface heat; use urgently to prevent later complications. This is Cimicifuga-Kudzu Decoction with added cicada slough, or forsythia alone. Decoct warm and take. Sheep-hoof combination, bring to full boil.

Half portion, cut and processed with one unit each of licorice and various other medicines, divided into two portions.

Decoct together with one sheng (unit of measure) of clear wine, boil until reduced, strain and keep the liquid; boil again with one sheng of clear wine, decoct together until the body is treated.

Hu Xi (Xanthium) Wine:

Concerning the bath and body treatment: if the limbs are slow and the patient shows signs of the swelling not surfacing properly, the rash and membrane condition must be monitored. translation:
Signs of Auspicious and Inauspicious Outcomes at the Time of Swelling and Eruption

[Regarding smallpox pustule development and prognosis:]

If the pustules are flat, sunken, and showing cold signs (伏寒), one should use internal medicine with added cloves (丁香), or wine-infused purple herb ointment (紫草膏). If the pustules turn purple and sunken, this indicates internal cold with excessive fire and hot blood; use ripe cloves or wine-mixed purple herb and four-fungi tooth powder. If purple coloring appears, use Bao Yuan formula.

If the swelling fails to rise and the eruption is delayed, with the pustules not developing outward, use silver flower (銀花) to regulate the blood, with peach kernel (桃仁) to break up obstruction.

If the head of the pustule suppurates and turns black, this is the toxin being discharged. If it is slow and the color turns red and active, use realgar (雄黃) mixed with cotton swabs, stir-fried nail shavings (甲), and silver flower to regulate the blood.

On days five and six, if the head of the pustule is full and red, round like a drum, and the patient is lively — this is an auspicious sign. If the core is hard like a nail and comes out quickly, this is normal and good.

If the pustules continue to emerge like millet seeds, filling the pores, round and projecting outward — this is the expected course.

If the roots are firm and solid, with no hollow center, the face is red and swollen, and the eyes appear like coin-holes — this is a sign of difficulty.

If the whole body is depressed, the crown of the head does not swell, black areas appear, the abdomen is distended, there is no appetite, the breath is weak, and the spirit is exhausted — these are inauspicious signs.

At the time of swelling, if the pustules spread throughout the body with sunken tops and fail to rise, with the eyes appearing hollow like coin-holes, this is due to [underlying deficiency and cold].

The auspicious signs at the time of swelling: the pustules rise with a bright, full, red, plump appearance like a drum, with firm solid roots, no hollow centers, with red swelling of the face like millet seeds filling the surface — these are the true signs of a favorable outcome.

Three Days of Pus Formation (Penetrating the Pus — Three Mornings)

To nourish the stomach qi and strengthen the flesh: if the pox does not rise and swell, wash with a decoction made from bran fiber and the juice of Indian mustard greens (Brassica campestris), which can promote the rising and recovery of the body.

Juice from pig skin and pork: boil and use together to wash; the bran fiber juice and Indian mustard juice can also promote the body's recovery.

[Caution against excessive swelling.]

When the pus is full and rising over three days, the stomach qi naturally rises on its own. The fundamental energy rises to the tip of the pox, and the qi fills outward from within.

At this time, if the pox appears moist and lustrous, the transformation is proceeding smoothly. The toxic qi and blood-heat accumulate inwardly, and the poison, having filled to capacity, seeks to be discharged outward from within.

Be cautious about the process of inoculation and sealing. The patient must drink the medicinal decoction. Use the extreme method for pig-tail type lesions. On the seventh day, if around the ninth morning the swelling has doubled, this is normal.

When the pus penetrates, the stomach qi flows outward and downward. If the patient cannot eat and the swelling does not rise, and the pox become dry and rough, and bloody lesions appear externally on the seventh day, death may follow.

When clear qi is restored and the flow is smooth, the patient may drink the medicinal decoction. Cold, dispersing, and cooling medicines should be used at this stage. If by the seventh day, swelling has doubled by the ninth morning, this is expected.

[For treating the pus-filled stage:] Use Danggui (Angelica), refined water, and other herbs. After the ninth day, if the fluid circulates well, use half the internal dose. Apply warming and dispersing formulas to relieve blood pressure [congestion]. If blood signs appear on the seventh day and the patient dies, observe the signs accordingly.

The true method of treating pus: use Danggui along with other herbs. After the ninth day, when the fluids recirculate, use half the internal dose with warming and dispersing medicines. Monitor the original qi carefully.

If the pus-toxin has not been resolved, by this stage vomiting of fluids will occur. If the cyclical fluids are well managed at this time and the original qi recovers with proper treatment, the pus will resolve doubly well.

If resolution has occurred after seven days but vigorous fever develops and the qi appears weak, use Detoxifying and Wind-Dispelling Decoction (解毒防風湯). If the qi is weak, use Return-to-Center Decoction (歸中湯).

For hoarseness accompanying the pox, use Detoxifying and Wind-Dispelling Decoction; if the qi is weak, use Return-to-Center Decoction accordingly.

translation:
Signs and Symptoms of True Pustule Formation (Classical Period)

When the pustules descend gradually, the sound reduces, and as they dry, the skin shows a green-tinged coloration; the patient experiences chills and battle-signs on the skin; the surface becomes dry and white; lesions like small pox-beans ripen and the scabs fall off naturally — this is a sign of recovery.

When there is complete absence of pus and blood in the discharge, when the color fades and the matter dries up of itself in time, scattering and descending, the result is that the sores become hard like dried beans, with the scab falling away and the color returning to normal — this too indicates resolution.

Three Days After Pustule Recession (Shou Lin San Zhao):

If the pustules do not recede sufficiently at the knees and lower legs, if the toxic pus does not fully form and scatter, if the color resembles purple-red like grapes, and the appearance is like dragon-brain or blue-green: this is considered the most effective sign for the physician to recognize. The treatment must block further spread and prevent the pus from not receding. If seams remain and there is blood-coloring present, recognize these signs accordingly.

If there is coughing and the teeth do not recede (i.e., the gums remain swollen), and if the legs remain affected: it is appropriate to use Baoyuan Tang (Preserve the Original Decoction) to scatter the condition. The formula must be examined and the dispersing administered until dryness results.

When pustule nests appear but refuse to express outward: regulate the binding water-filled lesions with Ganlu Juice (Sweet Dew Decoction) and Huiming Tian Yin formula, and the lesions will dry immediately.

When the disease retreats but blood deficiency is present and wind is not being released, and heat-steaming occurs internally: use Ganlu Juice combined with Huiming Tian Yin. Add cinnamon and Ganlu Juice back to the formula. The formula must be carefully reviewed, dispersal applied, and the lesions will dry.

Bowon-tang (Formula for Preserving the Original Qi)

Ingredients:
Ginseng (人參) 2 qian
Astragalus (黃芪) 1 [qian]
Licorice (草) 2 qian each
Prepare by cutting and chopping. Make into one packet. Add a small amount of red [ingredient].

Main text:

This formula addresses toxin conditions. When the medicinal is deficient, the dosage should be adjusted. For weak blood, add Cinnamon (官桂) to harmonize. Chen Pi (陳皮) resolves toxin. If the condition is one of deficiency, add Ligusticum (川芎) to move blood. If toxins are difficult to disperse, add Cinnamon in appropriate portions. When the color is poor and blood is weak, use Cinnamon to resolve toxin. Adjust the formula proportionally depending on the severity.

If cold is present and Wood Fragrance (木香) cannot control the Official Cinnamon, add Ligusticum. After seven to eight days, if heat persists, reduce the formula by ten to forty portions internally. If yang deficiency is present, the toxins will mature; once resolved, use Atractylodes.

If the stomach is not sufficiently full, add glutinous rice and Official Cinnamon accordingly.

If dampness is present, add to moisten; if the condition requires, strengthen the formula. After eight to eighteen days, if the qi transformation is difficult, the toxins will separate; use Atractylodes to assist.

Detoxification Section:

Initially, stir-fry with wine. When conditions such as food stagnation or accumulated disorders are present — such as in cases of alcohol-related masses — add Hawthorn (山楂). For toxin conditions where the poison is evident, clear it. Even if a family formula of several packets is used to resolve the toxin, one must continue.

If envy-like symptoms arise without apparent harm, and the patient is concerned about internal spread of toxin, this too must be addressed and cannot be ignored.

When heat is excessive, reduce the formula accordingly and adjust internally as appropriate.

Black Powder (Hei San Zi)

Take four liang of cinnabar, place it in a silk bag and suspend it in a ceramic jar, add decoction water, seal with fire, and process it by fire-refining method. Grind into powder, use yellow paper of matching color, apply with tea and honey; the white-colored ones are to be set with the fixed method, using the fire-引 method.

Refine and use red cinnabar: combine and fix, pound twice, grind three times, take together, use rice powder mixed proportionally, one qian per dose, adjust with one dose, one hammer-processed measure, one cinnabar portion, take below to resolve toxicity from pox and sores, remove toxic matter; initially when sores emerge from the mouth and are fire-calcined, preserve their nature, when they do not dissolve or come out, grind finely, each time two qian, bottled fresh.

Distinguishing the Forms, Colors, Goodness and Badness of Pox Lesions

Bright red indicates heat in the blood. When lesions first appear purple, this means extreme heat. Black lesions indicate raging toxin. Completely white lesions indicate deficiency of toxin-qi. Grayish-white lesions indicate cold blood with stagnant qi. Black indicates raging toxin.

When the pores and orifices are fully ripened, appearing black like a drill-point, this represents the essential vitality of the five viscera emerging. Red-yellow and pale red colors are favorable. Yellow-green indicates the toxin is just beginning to emerge; yellow-green lesions that persist become gangrenous sores.

When sores spread all over like they are fully ripened and severe, this is the true color of the toxin about to emerge, representing the essential vitality of the five viscera. Red-yellow and pale red are favorable; yellow-green indicates emerging toxin and may lead to gangrenous sores.

Dense lesions like coins or like a cap, soft and thin as water-soaked material, with roots inside the skin — when the illness is severe, the sores are severe, which is a counter-flow sign. Floating lesions, upon diagnosis, that appear glossy are half-mild and half-severe; lesions that resolve quickly in number are a favorable sign.

Lesions that crest at the top and emerge in an orderly manner are favorable. Sudden change to cool dampness turning black, with blood-pox turning black, emerging at the ears and skin — these are counter-flow signs. Soft and loose lesions that do not harden indicate a muddled prognosis.

The condition follows the pattern of spring and summer being favorable, autumn and winter involving the kidneys being unfavorable.

When the patient can eat and the bowels move regularly, this is the favorable sign. A physician considers regular appetite and smooth bowel movements as signs of proper flow. When the body is warm and the bowels move regularly, and lesions appear from head downward to the feet, this is the favorable pattern.

When lesions progress from feet up to the head, this is considered an exterior pattern. One should maintain a calm, moderate condition. When pox emerge, regular bowel movements, compliance with treatment, absence of thirst and dryness — these are signs of favorable prognosis.

Regulate through the gate [i.e., administer orally].

Voice/Sound (Loss of Voice)

When pox have already erupted and the voice does not change — this is a physical condition. If caused by wind-cold invasion, or by throat swelling, apply the detoxifying Fangfeng Decoction. If after detoxification the voice remains hoarse, [treat accordingly].

When the lungs are impaired, qi is exhausted, cold has entered internally, and the voice is lost before the pox scatter outward — this is a disorder of both body and heart/mind. When pox erupt and the dosage is doubled for throat pain, and the voice changes before eruption causing hoarseness, [treat as follows].

Regardless of whether cold is internal or the pox have not yet come out, when the voice also fails to emerge, use Jiegeng (Platycodon) Formula.

Throat Pain
When pox erupt poorly and the mouth and throat are painful, it is appropriate to use Detoxifying Drink (see Rusheng Drink formula). For throat pain, it is also suitable to swallow salt water dry. The heart and stomach are scorched by toxins, so with the Rusheng Drink formula, swallow dry from a bowl with water. When the throat membrane becomes blocked, use milk [preparations] as appropriate.

When water cannot be swallowed, or purple vomiting occurs, or the flesh must be lanced with a blade to remove toxins, or when sores form in the mouth, tongue, palate and throat preventing nursing, [use the following].

Pig's Trotter Formula: two trotters — for toxic blockage, using the bone broth plaster method to close and disperse toxins when they surface, or if sores form in the mouth, tongue, palate and throat...

[Add various ingredients to prevent toxins]

Rusheng Drink (如聖飲)

Lower Back and Abdominal Pain
When one is drowsy and the skin shows signs of dry erupted rashes, many die. When rashes cause abdominal pain at the rash sites, and the pain stops as fever rises, this may spare the kidneys from damage. Shengjie Decoction: take when rashes appear, induce sweating...

For pain: nine fen of gypsum (shigao), add Jiegeng, bamboo leaves, one to three slices each, burdock seed (niubangzi) and licorice (gancao), various amounts — the formula is the same for all types of lower back pain. Since lower back and abdominal pain often appears at the onset of eruption, causing back pain, one should exhaust all measures [to treat it promptly].

translation:
Modified Red Cotton Powder (加減紅綿散)

Regulate and open [the pores]; suitable for toxic heat lodged internally, or when the illness has turned inward. Formula uses black fat (rendered lard), acts like citrus peel. Take decoction. Each ingredient: five fen of sprouts, stone-[herb], gold crocodile scale, one day; apply thin patch; enter water-chestnut back, purple-white herb stem, same [amount].

Vomiting and Retching (喧吐)
When vomiting appears together with rashes, if the patient vomits and has diarrhea, this is not necessarily dangerous — it can be managed. If the rashes appear and then the bowels produce pus, this is described as the evil pathogen being exhausted from its nest.
When vomiting is natural heat expelling upward at the early stage, there is no harm. If after the rashes appear there is diarrhea with purulent discharge, that is a bad sign.
If vomiting and diarrhea occur together with pure worms, excessive blazing fire, upward staring of the eyes, loss of spirit, and inability to have bowel movements — those patients will die.
It is appropriate to use Stabilizing the Center Decoction (定中湯), adding cloves, cold-natured herbs, licorice, for abdominal pain, to unblock and promote bowel movement.

Stabilizing the Center Decoction (定中湯)
For patients with stomach cold unable to stop vomiting and diarrhea — this is a wonderful formula. Take one hundred boiling [spoonfuls of] water to steep it, cover and do not let it separate.
Use flying [processed] [ingredients], two liang, add a little sand [mineral], add to diarrhea, use genuine correct yellow earth (terra flava), do not combine improperly.
[Huang wen] right side use two liang, add cinnamon bark, steep, take five fen portions with water to finish.
Extremely avoid sand, add to [treat] eye conditions, processed by flying, take with rice [water], five fen, finish with water.
White poria, angelica, medicinal herbs, decoct and take, smooth the intestines, for slippery diarrhea, urgently use ginseng-preserving-origin [formula].

Diarrhea (泄瀉)
Alisma [herb], dryness, fragrance, one grain, the size of a large bean, ground into powder, red bundle, or diarrhea, both taken mixed, or abdominal distension, or shortness of breath — these are the signs.
[When] the herb's effect is seen afterward, add extremely [to] cinnamon bark, avoid white poria, start the medicine, take at the right time, processed, take with light rice-water, smooth the intestines, finish, for slippery diarrhea.

translation:
When both exterior and interior are deficient, it is appropriate to use Igong Decoction (異功煎), swallowing down with water along with Nutmeg Pills (肉豆蔲九). This is because the fluids of the stomach and intestines are insufficient. Wood Aromatic Powder (木香散) is appropriate when there is deficiency of fluids. Although the diarrhea may occur, if qi and blood are insufficient, one must stop the diarrhea; it is appropriate to use Igong Powder (異功散), swallowed down with water along with Nutmeg Pills. The interior stomach fluids are insufficient.

Igong Powder (異功散)
Treats dysentery with abdominal diarrhea, coldness of the feet and knees, while the upper body is warm. Use this for abdominal diarrhea with cold feet extending past the knees but warmth above. This addresses abdominal diarrhea where cold shivering occurs.
Ingredients: Three fen each; cinnamon, cloves, atractylodes; two fen each; white [atractylodes]; half fen each; prepared aconite; three portions; dried ginger; half portion; chen pi (tangerine peel); pinellia; one portion; magnolia bark; ginseng — various amounts.

Wood Aromatic Powder (木香散)
Right [preparation]: For conditions with much reddish [stool], phlegm-heat, applied at the knees — for diarrhea with aucklandia, large [doses of] aroma, cooked water, not suitable to take before this [treatment]; cinnamon twig, licorice root, tangerine peel, each half; pinellia.
[Various conditions may be treated]: For red [conditions], can be used for heat patterns. With dampness present and the right amount, can be decocted and taken. For abdominal [conditions] with cloves, aucklandia, cooked [preparation], if this cannot be served, use these thicker portions with ginseng, various amounts.

Nutmeg Pills (肉豆蔲九)
Three qian each: grind to powder — nutmeg, processed red halloysite (赤石脂), white [poria], various; alum (枯礬) seven qian and a half; white [poria].
Take with liquid: one-year-old children thirty pills; three-year-old children one hundred pills; blend with aucklandia and cardamom (縮砂).

Divide and decoct. Take equal parts of: Aucklandia root (木香), Tangerine peel (陳皮), Terminalia fruit (訶子), Nutmeg (肉豆蔻), White Poria (白茯苓), White Atractylodes (白朮), Honey-fried Licorice (甘草炙) — each three parts.

Wheezing and Panting (疾喘)

[Appended to the Cough section, used together with the preceding formulas.] Peucedanum root and Bitter Orange Shell. Cut into pill form using the preceding cough decoction. The formula above can be seen in the Descending Phlegm Decoction. The general formula stops [the condition]. When the sound heard from beside the nose is high and the phlegm attacks upward with yellow earth [colored phlegm], use Yangwei Wujing formula together, boiled in water and taken. translation:
On tooth and gum symptoms, if the disease has progressed repeatedly and there is heat and the patient cannot take medicines, cannot stop diarrhea, if wrongly treated, harm will come swiftly as a turning of the palm.

When the gums are affected, and repeated irritation and diarrhea occur, one must not fail to stop the diarrhea; if wrongly used, warming the feet and giving the base formula with musk is indicated.

Dissipating and purging: for rashes and sores with frequent diarrhea, items such as persimmon, watermelon, and pear, cut into pieces, must not be given lest toxins attack inward; it is also appropriate to use the abdominal formula combined with musk.

Honey water and concentrated red: for measles rashes with irritation and heat that can be treated, if there is abdominal distension, one should not drink; the abdominal formula combined with musk is appropriate.

For cases of chills and shivering, dryness, dispersal of pus, loss of fluid, if the condition does not stop immediately, avoid letting the rash fall back inward; if there is much diarrhea, do not allow toxins to linger in the water; the abdominal formula combined with musk is indicated.

When the rash is sparse and weak, does not scatter properly, and falls late, and there is watery diarrhea causing bleeding, the abdominal formula combined with musk is indicated.

Jade Powder Decoction with Five Seeds: decoct and take; for white pox and eruption rashes, use the preventing-and-stopping formula; add plum and if blood appears in stool, the abdominal-qi formula is indicated.

Flower Powder Jade Five-Seed Decoction: decoct and take; to stabilize and resolve, cut and do not use the plain decoction; add Ophiopogon to purge excessive rash.

When it is difficult, with much urination and scanty toxin-fire, moxibustion on the rash; to promote eruption and reduce the condition; when the patient is in danger of death, use Yiyi Grass Decoction, stop noodle-eating; drink the excess-rash decoction.

Licorice Decoction (Gancao Tang)

Treats abdominal distension.

Abdominal distension arises from stomach deficiency, causing bloating. Drinking too much water and having sores on the teeth with abdominal distension is not suitable for the patient. One should regulate water intake. When the spleen is congested, abdominal distension occurs. Drinking alcohol and having sores on the teeth with abdominal distension requires regulation. Drinking too much water with yin injury and sores causing abdominal distension should be treated appropriately. Muxiang San (Costus Root Powder) is for abdominal distension caused by toxic qi, internal sores, and chronic abdominal bloating with toxin spreading — the patient should regulate intake. Take dispersing formula for spleen-related abdominal distension.

[Preparation:] Same as above, cut and decoct in water: licorice (gancao), trichosanthes root (gualou gen), equal parts.

Spontaneous Sweating (Bai Han)

In pox disease, when the patient dies from the illness and the sores first arise, spontaneous sweating is a defense mechanism. It is difficult to stop because the heat builds up and steams outward, causing sweating after eruption — this is the natural course. It is strictly forbidden to stop the sweating in those who sweat excessively, as it is hard to halt. Use Baoyuan Tang (Preserve the Source Decoction) if it is difficult to stop. Use blood-staunching membrane to stop sores, harmonize the muscles, moisten, and take foods that do not harm.

For spontaneous sweating in pox disease, use Shen Zhu Yin (Ginseng and Atractylodes Drink) to stop it.

Itching and Pain

Foot blood is constantly rubbed and chafed; use decoctions to stop bleeding and membranes to stop sore itching. This is caused by food toxins. Harmonize muscles, moisten the affected areas, and ensure the pox can come out freely. Use Dahuang (rhubarb) and Huanglian (coptis) to activate, moisten blood, and help the pox erupt outward. Mix salt water with stone herbs to promote eruption. Mix charcoal smoke decoction for abdominal itching to stop the condition. When pus first emerges, pain is expected.

Add processed aconite, stir-fried ingredients, and fried licorice with frost to the decoction for severe pain. For abdominal itching with toxic accumulation, use rhubarb and coptis to activate and moisten the pox and skin conditions. To stop itching immediately, use the pus-drawing formula when pus first emerges.

Use Shen Su Yin (Ginseng and Perilla Drink), Zhu Fu decoction with feather rinse, and stir-fried mixtures to stop burning and abdominal itching. When pus first emerges, pain at this stage is to be expected.

translation:
Teeth Grinding (Bruxism)

Regarding the upper and lower teeth grinding together: according to the theory of the teeth, when heat is extreme, this is called toxic heat entering the gums and jaw. This enters the stomach organ; when Yang enters, the teeth clench—this is what is called teeth grinding. It is also called tight clenching. The essential point for prevention: the toxin enters the stomach organ, and Yang then causes black jaundice, with the mouth tightly shut—this is a key sign requiring attention.

Loss of Blood

During epidemic pestilence, when blood issues from the stool and urine simultaneously—this is called loss of blood. When the heat is excessive with nosebleed and blood in the urine that does not stop, one should use Iho-roga Powder. If heat and jaundice do not stop, use Hwangji Decoction. If sores appear but there is no blood below and the stool is closed, this is dead blood; treatment is also difficult and death may result. When blood from the mouth, ears, and nose does not stop, one should use Iho-roga Powder.

Difficult Urination

When there is mental irritability and the patient has constipation—if there is also itching and constipation causing restlessness and difficult bowel movements, and likewise difficult urination, one should use Cheongeum Decoction. If one wishes to use roasted [herbs], use Daehwang-yeon [rhubarb-coptis]. Also, when the nine orifices are closed and urination is difficult, clearing the urine will open the passages. For sore toxins, use [herbs] internally with Coptis.

Ginseng and Cicada Molting Powder (人參蟬蛻散)

Ingredients: Ginseng, cicada molting (蟬蛻), licorice root—each five pun; akebia stem (木通), white poria (白茯苓), red poria (赤茯苓), arnebia/gromwell leaf (紫草葉).

Method: Cut into one packet, decoct in water and take orally.

Additionally: Akebia stem (木通), arnebia leaf (紫草葉), large abdominal skin (大腹皮).

Oil and Sauce Method
To treat internally: blend well and use a small bamboo tube to insert into the rectum. Let it flow naturally through. Use fragrant oil and clear sauce — one measure of each. Insert through the anal opening, take one measure of oil sauce, and instill it into the bamboo tube until it reaches ten portions, causing the person to feel it. Cut off [the flow].

Inverted Sore (Dao Lou)
Using a tube-shaped object, push into the rectum and let it flow naturally. Or insert into the anal opening, take one measure of oil sauce and instill it into the bamboo [tube]. This is what is called "inverted sore." When injured, qi becomes deficient and cannot rise — this is called inverted sore. Warm-dispersing [formula] is appropriate. If [the sore] comes out, sweating is not appropriate. For inverted pox-rash that turns white [pallid]:

If caused by external pathogen: if the mechanical [rash] does not erupt, adjust accordingly. When [the condition] appears as inverted sore, use warming and dispersing [approach], preserve the original [qi], disperse [the pathogen], and regulate. For inverted sore with interior cold: warm, disperse, preserve the original, regulate and resolve. [In all such cases] the pathogen should come out; if it does not, do not force sweating.

When the flow is not free and there is what people commonly call "inverted sore" — at that time it resembles a bean penetrating the surface, the water does not rise, it becomes hard. One should drink water to resolve it. Inverted pox-rash: stop the pox-rash from fading [turning white]. If [the patient] lacks appetite and [the condition is] unfavorable, and there is inverted sore, have the person take [the formula]; because of this, regulate and resolve. It is appropriate to take Baoyuan San (Preserve the Origin Powder). Drink the decoction according to the formula. [If] inverted sore cannot [be resolved by] sweating, and inverted pox-rash turns white, stop the pox-rash.

Resolving Dispersal Powder (Tiaojie San)
Ingredients, sliced: Purple herb, Aged tangerine peel (Chen Pi), Platycodon root (Jie Geng), Bitter orange (Zhi), dried chrysanthemum, Licorice root, Angelica root (Dang Gui), Purple perilla leaf — each three fen; Ginseng — one fen; Pinellia (Ban Xia) — one half; Ligusticum (Chuan Xiong).

Water Poplar Decoction (Shui Yang Tang)
Bathing in this has a miraculous effect for treating inverted sores that will not come to a head.

黑疸

可疑不究諸陰伏倒鬱黑疸毒氣入裏爛心神妄命四者而黑疸最危尾危

觸犯不微污染入黑陰毒者服浸再盛狂叱宜散群方。

視真門戰。交。牙疸赤疸入內毒黑陰疸者服浸再盛以五十紫齊。

侯疸九真下出汗之耳尾反氣熱或溫黃者十盞水意四可百黑者或藥齒散一百其方。

身祥胛不黑者腎故惡己寒飲戴盛水肺脾能治黑腎如也身寒熱不欲。

飲水一齊黑乾風散者為腎陰終身而令不能齊黑者故也將也身寒熱欲。

translation:
Black Jaundice (Hei Dan)

Black jaundice is a condition associated with hidden yin patterns. When toxic qi invades inward, it causes internal putrefaction, mental confusion, and delirium. Among the four types, black jaundice is the most dangerous.

When the body is invaded by contamination and toxic qi penetrates inward, black yin toxin accumulates. The patient should be given soaking medicines repeatedly until the condition stabilizes, using formulas from the group of fifty-some prescriptions.

When jaundice reaches the gate of true qi, the patient sweats, the ears and extremities become cold, the body becomes hot or feverish, and yellow coloration appears. Water intake in the stomach and spleen is affected; one hundred treatments and their formulas are listed.

When the patient's body turns black and the kidneys are affected, the patient develops cold and heat alternation and loss of desire to drink. Administer Green Dry Wind-Dispelling Powder with modifications according to the condition.

If the kidneys are depleted with yin deficiency, the condition becomes terminal; the patient cannot recover. Administer Green Dry Wind-Dispelling Powder with added ingredients; use Large Dispersing Powder, End-Wind Powder, or see if ulcerations appear — then black patches emerge and the condition becomes critical.

If the toxic qi enters the viscera, the patient will die. For agitation and restlessness, use Return-to-Life Powder or Calm Knee Powder. If the patient develops hiccups, ghost-speech, or sores that are not quickly treated, the condition becomes irreversible.

Use Pig-Tail Paste, Holy Powder, and Sweet Powder to restore vital qi. Use Tranquil Wind Precious Intestine Paste, or Zi Wei, or Fang Feng formulas if the body collapses and the fetal position is affected.

Add Six-Ingredient Powder. For black yin spotting, jaundice appearing in the eyes, erect pupils, and acute blackening of the extremities — urgently administer Cooked-Heat formula for conditions like Heavenly Fire.

Use Two-Horn Decoction with caution. For visible black yin manifestations with jaundice in the eyes, erect pupils, and acute blackening — when body heat and toxin are at their peak, the condition is critical.

Civet Fat Ointment
From the four corners of the eyes to both eyes — when the eyelid pustules first appear, they stick to the fontanelle region; once the surface skin forms, the pockmark will not scar. When pox pustules first emerge, immediately apply a paste made with gardenia (栀子) ground fine and mixed with water — do not let it enter the eyes. Formula for Eliminating Scars
If the pox does not continue to be moistened with oil or honey, it hardens and necessarily recedes, then causes pain; it is advisable to let blood emerge from the fine, tender skin. Apply moisture with one liang of fly-maggot water to keep the sores soft and moist.

Frequently moisten with dried butter (酥), or otter fat, or decoction juice mixed with honey — this can astonish and eliminate scars. One liang applied to sores, one or two applications of fly-maggot water. Keep pox sores soft and moist.

Using the black, raised method with butter or fat — for convex or concave sore depressions, apply the juice daily; use the scar-eliminating bone marrow formula, apply daily to the pustules. One dose disperses the pox sores, or use refined decoction lightly on the sores to keep them moist.

After the powder falls off, for blackened areas, use the scar-eliminating formula. Apply half a dose of pus-reducing ointment daily; use the scar-eliminating method. One or two applications of fly-maggot water with refined light decoction.

Apply to the face: use one qian each morning, wash off, grind and use the scar-eliminating formula. Apply half a portion daily, ground fine for the sores.

Freshwater Clam Water
Do not use much of this — raise freshwater clams in water for five days; each day take this water to wash the area.

Treatment formula:
The Sparse-Pox Decoction is the secret-transmitted Sparse-Pox preparation. When the nine pox have scabbed over, take this decoction, warm it slightly, and wash the face — there will be no scars. After pox rash heals and then breaks out again — or if there is qi deficiency after recovery causing extreme weakness, the body swaying even while seated or lying down — it is appropriate to use Hualong [formula]. After recovery, if the mouth turns black and purple with convulsions, use [the appropriate formula].

After pox heals, if there is heart pain without vomiting, use Huasan. If one cannot sleep soundly and toxins accumulate, use Huaben Nine [pills]. After recovery, if untimely convulsions appear, [treat accordingly].

After pox heals, if there is severe heat, hoarseness, and trembling, use Tianhua Powder. If the pox ulcerate and the toxins go inward, [use] Ruxiang (frankincense) powder.

After horse-pox, if after seven days there is severe hoarseness and trembling, attach Tianhua Powder. For yin-toxin type, use [the relevant formula].

If lung deficiency causes tooth decay and urticaria, take Jiedu (detoxifying) decoction, Xiaodu (toxin-dispersing) drink, or Sandou (three-bean) drink.

Sunken Measles (Hahm-ma) formula.

At the initial onset of measles eruptions, one must use Sansam (ginseng). When the measles rash first appears, divine spirit is present in the sweat — use this to clear and disperse. Purple Perilla leaf medicine is appropriate for clearing and dispersing measles.

After measles eruption, if the remaining toxin remains internally and there is urinary retention with white turbid urine and the toxin attacks the lungs and stomach, with heat in the stomach and feverish sweating — use Rhinoceros Horn in the center of this.

If the sweating is moistening and the skin becomes lustrous like wax, this dissolves the condition. After three days, the measles pox on both sides bite (itch), and so the toxic disease causes red sores. Today it is commonly called skin-heat stomach-heat.

The usual method is to have the patient speak to themselves — this is the formula for when the condition manifests on the surface. Afterward use Sohong-nang-tang (Purple-Red Wave Decoction). Initially begin with Purple Perilla leaf medicine, which is appropriate for clearing and dispersing measles.

Rehmannia (dihuang) toxin fumigation: steam and moisten to bring out the skin's resolution, until the skin becomes lustrous like wax. Three times daily the measles pox on both sides itch — adjust the toxic disease: the red sores are now commonly called skin-heat stomach-heat.

Soga-tang (Purple Perilla and Kudzu Decoction): Commonly known as Purple Perilla-Kudzu Root Skin Decoction with Amomum (縮砂), ground and crushed, each 5 pun, combined and added to Welsh onion white (葱白), two doses of medicine, fresh ginger, three portions of land.

Soga-tang: Take as decoction with water.

Onion White Decoction (葱白湯): Take without restriction as to amount, decoct in water, take the liquid as a drink.

Kudzu Root and Ophiopogon Powder (葛根麥門冬散): Cimicifuga (升麻), Red Poria (赤茯苓), as medicine — Ophiopogon (麥門冬) each 6 pun, Ginseng (人參), Licorice (甘草) each 3 pun. Right [i.e., the above ingredients].

Indigo Leaf Juice (藍葉汁): Drink it; also treats dan toxin (erysipelas) that has entered the interior with heat — extract and use.

Huanglian: Pound into powder, form into pills, take three times daily. Also treats [pediatric conditions].

Puhuang: Used with rice to treat nosebleed; also benefits and nourishes young children when mixed and prepared.

Suanjiang: Removing [toxins], beneficial for children to eat; greatly benefits and nourishes young children.

Wangua: Dry and seal, burn to powder, effective for treating children's diseases; also expels roundworms and tapeworms; place the powder inside [the remedy] to immediately expel worms.

Shijunzi: Remove the shell and use the kernel inside; children eat it for parasitic infections and roundworms, which are expelled immediately. For children of three years, use half a qian; or one qian.

Tiannanxing: Mix with pig bile, combine with one portion, blend with chicken bile, apply below; removes the skin; the bile paste, when formed into powder, can treat children of three years at half a qian or one qian.

Pianxu: Decoct pig bile juice with the herb; effective for children's toxic conditions, take three to four times daily.

Xue Gen: Treats children's toxic conditions; the common name is [given]; for children of three years who cannot walk, take the bark, grind finely, take one qian each time, three times daily, to promote movement and walking.

Wujiapi: Blend with good wine, take a small amount, three times daily.

translation:
Bamboo Leaves: Treats fever and fright in children. Decoct and give as a drink. Use with small dose.

Willow Catkins: Can be used warm and soft as a preparation. Excellent, as their nature is soft and gentle.

Turtle Urine: Treats children with extreme symptoms — nasal hair loss, facial yellowing, and wasting. Take the bile, drip it in, burn to ash, grind to powder and apply. Applied to the child's head, the condition resolves in five days.

Crucian Carp: [Used for conditions of] the nasal area [formula incomplete].

Wasp's Nest: Treats internal conditions. Burn the nest, take the reddish residue, grind it to powder, mix with wine and take one qian dose daily. Regulates urination and defecation.

Soft-shelled Turtle Shell: For children with open fontanelle — take the bile, burn to ash, mix together and apply to the fontanelle area.

Crab Shell: For children with skin eruptions, redness, night restlessness, and body sores — grind to powder and take as a drink. Also applied externally for pox and bruising; very effective as a drink.

Cicada Molting: For erysipelas spreading through the body — soak in liquid, take the preparation and drink.

translation:

Treats children's [wind conditions affecting the mouth]: grind into powder, mix with the child's saliva to adjust, administer; treats wind sores of the lips and mouth area, apply inside the lips and it will heal quickly.

White Stiff Silkworm (白殭蠶)
Add two branches [of the ingredient]; grind into powder, mix with honey, use as medicine; apply to the diaphragm area for wind conditions.

Garden Snail (蝸牛)
Treats children's sores and scabs on the face and mouth; burn to ash, grind into powder, and apply.

Toad (蟾蜍)
Treats children's sores and scabs, painful boils (丁): burn to ash for powder and apply; or wrap in yellow clay and burn, remove the bones, take the medicinal portion; used for debilitating conditions in children.

Male Rat Meat (牡鼠肉)
Used to harmonize children's constitution; combined with other flavors, given along with Lingzhi mushroom and eaten often; helps strengthen bones and restore vitality in debilitated children.

Male Rat Droppings (雄鼠糞)
Treats children who at twenty-one days of age have not yet grown teeth: take twenty-one pellets, use one pellet per day to rub on the tip of the gum; the pointed-tip ones are male rat droppings.

Small Eel (小鰻)
Treats children's red and white sores; pound and crush, extract the juice; treats hundreds of kinds of red toxic swellings and various types of boils; mix and apply to sores, or burn to ash and take orally.

Snake Slough (蛇蛻)
Used for large sores on a child's body; burn it, mix with aged lard, apply to the sores; or burn to ash and take orally.

Mosquito Larva/Water Bug (蚊蜮)
For children who cannot move or walk properly; roast until done, form into pills, and administer.

Treats swelling from toxic sores in infants, including "dragon dung" toxin, spreading swellings, and moon-erosion sores. Use centipede with mother's milk and take orally. Also effective.

Seven treatments: primarily for infants with vomiting, fire-heat, drinking; also for five-colored, red, and white tinea. Effective.

Grape
Mix the powder with blue-green earth, take internally; also apply juice externally for washing. Beneficial.

Dried Persimmon
For children: grind, make into autumn paste, take with the above.

translation:
Pear
Treats heart conditions, lung heat, tooth decay. According to Han, it nourishes the lungs. Take a good pear, remove the core, drink the juice mixed with honey warmed, eat it. For tooth decay, apply to the gums until soft.

Sesame (胎麻)
For tooth decay. According to Han, grind to powder and mix. For children's erysipelas (red skin toxin), pound and apply. Take a suitable amount, drink it. Softens until the hands become soft. Pound and apply.

Adzuki Bean (赤小豆)
Mix and treat children's head sores and white-headed sores, erysipelas, and toxins. Grind to powder, mix, and for children's erysipelas, pound and apply.

Melon Seed (麥瓜仁)
Decoct or slowly take by mouth for wind-type convulsions (鸞風). Apply the powder or decoct and take the liquid. Also treats wind conditions.

Winter Melon Seed (冬瓜仁)
Mainly used for children's convulsive wind disorders. Boil in water, take the decocted juice, drink it. Excellent for internal consumption. Also used for abscesses and carbuncles.

Mint (薄荷)
Mainly used afterward, stored and applied. Boil in water and combine with the decoction. Apply internally to the stomach. Drink and apply to treat various conditions.

Ma Lan (馬藺)
Treats various conditions. Use after storing. If recovery is not fast, the complexion becomes pale and dull. Apply ointment internally, take herbal drink; if dry, apply again.

Mustard Seed (芥子)
Quickly draws out toxins. Use to treat slow recovery when the color is pale and not ruddy and the skin is not moist. Apply ointment, give herbal drink internally; if dry, apply again.

Chicken Intestine Herb (雞腸草)
Treats children's red infantile malnutrition (赤疳). Pound and extract juice, mix and drink it. Very effective.

translation:
Water (Juice from Water Plantain): Treats sudden weakness and collapse with vomiting and diarrhea in children. Pound and extract juice and give to drink, or boil and drink the decoction. Taken from a boot worn by the mother — burn the fingernail clippings from both hands of the mother.

Human Fingernail Ash: Treats newborn children. Mix with nine hemp seeds, the size of a large grain, and swallow with well water. Burn needles.

Hair Ash: Treats fever with sweating in children and various ailments. Used with the large boot; make a fried cake and apply with it.

Chicken Egg: Principally treats children who stop eating, body ailments, and various diseases. Fry with chicken, mix with yellow wax, and apply as a poultice.

White Duck: Principally treats fine hair [conditions] in children. Boil the head, use the broth; cover swelling, grind to a powder, mix with lard, and apply as a poultice.

Goose Feather: Take from a young bird, use the soft shaft and flexible cloth to wrap around, making the nature [of the treatment] suitable, and cover at night.

Night-Brightness Sand (Bat Droppings): Principally treats children's skin sores,府, and various malnutrition conditions (gan). Called "night brightness" because it glows at night. Cover the small mouse.

Hawk/Kite Droppings: Principally treats pork-related black maggot cough with urinary problems. Remarkably effective. Prepared from a young bird that has not yet eaten the night-brightness sand.

Cormorant: Treats children whose father's speech has caused diarrhea. From the cormorant's droppings.

Hundred-Tongue Bird (Mockingbird): This is what doctors today call it. Its name comes from its ability to mimic many birds. A remedy from the raptor birds.

For children's fright epilepsy and related conditions: take the central kernel [of musk], one piece.
Cinnabar (砂)

translation:
Acupuncture and Moxibustion Methods

For newborns with umbilical wind (neonatal tetanus) and lockjaw: when all medicines are ineffective, needle Rangu (Yongquan area) 8 fen deep. For both male and female, also take Yinlingquan, 7 moxa cones. For males treat yang side, females treat yin side, each burn 2 moxa cones. Main point: burn moxa at Haizhong; if the condition is critical, do not exceed 14 cones; those who can receive moxibustion should receive the full number of cones. For acute and chronic fright wind that is extremely dangerous, moxa Baihui and 8 surrounding points, 3 fen deep; if it flares at night, treat the intestinal channel 3 fen, for pox sores in the middle. If Baihui shows vessel depth of 3 fen and pox sores flare at night, moxa Yintang. Additionally, for males use left foot, for females use right foot, moxa at the base of the large toe nail, one unit at a time going in sequence.

When there is heart deficiency between the two nipples: for males use the left side, for females use the right side, near the hand border, at Yanglingquan, moxa half a cone at the nail edge, at the seam of two fingers.

Using moxa the size of half a grain of wheat on the flesh, three cones each, straddling the seam; first treat the back then the front, for males treat left hand side, this can also treat females on the left border, for epilepsy and convulsions, apply half a cone at the nail base.

Moxa cones the size of barley grain; when both sides are done, the patient can be treated for slow fright wind with swollen feet; use a gradual approach for evidence-based treatment; use compounded medicines for various epilepsies; for small children use half a cone, mixed with wine and powder.

Moxa like the size of half a wheat grain, make a small cone of skin with blue-green [herb]; barley-sized, both sides done; for riding-seam sores apply moxa above and below, left 5 cones right side as well, remove the fatty greasy matter from each point, apply half a unit.

For wren-tail bone below: one barley grain, flip nine, five tiger [points], each moxa on the left 5 cones right side, removing fat from each, also bilateral breast, diaphragm, and front transport points, moxa three cones each.

For the abdomen, apply ointment, stop at the cone point, dry as before, until easy, one barley grain, flip nine, five tiger, child's back, take the transport points of both sides, front transport points, moxibustion three cones each.

Small wheat grain size, from spring equinox going downward, moxa down the spine; in winter go from above, for children take bilateral transport points, do not exceed the method given.

For each type of moxibustion that shows no effect: for non-closure of the fontanelle and for children's umbilical qi, moxa Zhongwan twice.

translation:
Dongui Bogam, Miscellaneous Diseases Section, Volume 11

Moxibustion points: apply 7 moxa cones at each gate point. For treating epilepsy/convulsions, the points are located on the child's back, two points on either side of the midline. Use three copper coins placed along the spine to locate the spinal points; the points are on both sides of the spine. Apply moxibustion at both side points. For treating childhood epilepsy, the points are on the back midline; apply moxibustion at each point. Apply 7 moxa cones. Use three copper coins to locate the points along the spine; apply moxibustion at the points on both sides of the spine, until bleeding, and the condition will improve. For the Neiting point, apply 1 moxa cone. If a child develops prolonged convulsions/epilepsy, apply moxibustion at each indicated point. For cholera, males apply to the left, females to the right, 1 moxa cone; at the Dazhui and Renzhong and Baihui points. For the points on both hands at the third toe nail base, apply moxibustion 3 times. At the tip of the bone near the hairline, apply 1 moxa cone. At the Fuyang and Dajia points, combine and apply moxibustion.

Apply 1 moxa cone at the popliteal crease. For childhood rectal prolapse, apply moxibustion at the transverse skin crease.

Apply moxibustion within 1 cun of the transverse crease for rectal prolapse.
For childhood rectal prolapse, apply moxibustion at the flesh point with moxa.
